question: What carriers do we work with?
agent_answer:
We work with 3 carriers (TMS):

| ID | Name | Type | Cost/kg | Avg Transit |
|----|------|------|---------|-------------|
| CAR-001 | Kerry Express | Ground | 15 THB | 2 days |
| CAR-002 | SCG Cold Chain | Refrigerated | 25 THB | 1 day |
| CAR-003 | Flash Express Premium | Refrigerated | 35 THB | 1 day |

Note: refrigerated products **must** use CAR-002 or CAR-003. Kerry Express (CAR-001) is ground only and cannot be used for perishable/cold-chain items.
